lookback_hours.description: The window the earlier GitHub searches already applied when selecting closed and opened issues. Used for the headline label only — this skill does no time filtering of its own.

project_title.description: Display name of the board, for the digest headline. Defaults to "Development Project".

repositories.description: The owner/repo scope the caller applied. When the board spans repos beyond this list, the digest says so.

project_items.description: Optional fallback for callers that pass the board inline. On JoyStream leave it unbound: the board arrives as the full output of the earlier board-read step. Current board contents — the SCOPE SET. Every reported ticket must appear here.

status.description: Current board status column, verbatim. Current value only — never a history.

html_url.description: The item's web address, exactly as GitHub returned it (html_url).

closed_issues.description: Optional fallback for callers that pass the issues inline. On JoyStream leave it unbound: closed issues arrive as the full output of the earlier closed-issue search. Issues whose closed_at falls inside the window, already filtered by the caller.

linked_pr.description: The PR that closed the issue, when the caller resolved one.

html_url.description: The item's web address, exactly as GitHub returned it (html_url).

comments.description: Trailing issue comments — the gist fallback when there is no linked PR.

html_url.description: The item's web address, exactly as GitHub returned it (html_url).

opened_issues.description: Optional fallback for callers that pass the issues inline. On JoyStream leave it unbound: opened issues arrive as the full output of the earlier opened-issue search. Issues whose created_at falls inside the window, already filtered by the caller.

html_url.description: The item's web address, exactly as GitHub returned it (html_url).

in_progress_statuses.description: Board status values to treat as in-progress. Absent, treat any status that is neither a done nor a backlog column as in-progress.

trigger_type.description: How the run started — manual, cron, or agent_call. Selects draft vs finished tone.

now.description: The run's current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta.generated_at. Optional: absent, the run start time stated in the instructions is used. Never guessed.
